fusions.name: Upsweep
fusions.desc: Scoops everything in an arc 3 tiles ahead on the shield's upturned edge and throws it, dealing 12 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Sidestep Jab
fusions.desc: Jabs with the shield's rim, which deals 7 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after. It holds 3 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bolt Under Cover
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: First to Flinch
fusions.desc: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You gain +5% dodge chance.
